project.name: HeartWrite
project.summary: A private, local-first writing and roleplay workspace organized around StoryBooks.

features.name: Local StoryBook memory
features.oneLiner: Authors can preserve, recover, revise, and safely prepare StoryBook memories for later context.

stories.title: Save and read a memory for a StoryBook
stories.note: Built and checked locally; not deployed to real users.

stories.title: Keep the original when a memory is revised
stories.note: Revisions create separate records so the original remains recoverable.

stories.title: Reload saved memories after the app opens again
stories.note: Checked through the local persistence seam; packaged write-path verification remains limited.

stories.title: Recover a memory that needs a StoryBook
stories.note: The ownership transition is tested; the author-facing recovery screen is not built yet.

stories.title: Prepare safe memories for a StoryBook prompt
stories.note: The read boundary is built and checked; live prompt-compiler wiring is not built yet.

stories.title: Move memories aside when a StoryBook is archived
stories.unsure: The lifecycle coordinator and integration tests exist; no author-facing archive/delete control calls it yet.

decisions.what: Keep local memory contracts provider- and UI-independent before wiring cloud services or a larger writing surface.
Preserve memories for author recovery instead of deleting them automatically when a StoryBook is archived.

unsure: The packaged desktop write path has not been fully verified through the live UI.
The prompt projection has not yet been connected to a live generation request.

activity.what: Local memory ownership, recovery, persistence, and prompt-boundary checks passed.

features.name: Private StoryEval review
features.oneLiner: Power users can inspect aggregate evaluation runs without exposing private fixture text.

stories.title: Save and compare local evaluation runs
stories.note: Built and checked behind the private tools boundary; not deployed.

stories.title: Export an aggregate evaluation report
stories.note: Exports are checked for raw fixture leakage.

stories.title: Use the private review board in the packaged desktop app
stories.note: Installed packaged app opens the private StoryEval board; fixture execution and export remain covered by automated checks.

decisions.what: Keep StoryEval as a private power-user tool and remove it from the public production surface.

unsure: The board reflects the latest recorded verification; no production deployment exists.

activity.what: Local history, comparison, export, and leakage checks are covered by the test suite.
Installed packaged HeartWriteAI app visibly rendered the private StoryEval Review Dashboard and its run, history, compare, and export controls.

features.name: Local Character Book storage
features.oneLiner: Reusable Character Book records have a validated repository boundary before StoryBook attachment is added.

stories.title: Save and reload reusable Character Book records
stories.note: Repository and shared local persistence adapter are tested locally; no UI or StoryBook attachment is claimed.

decisions.what: Treat Character Book records as reusable masters; StoryBook attachment will be a separate relationship contract.

unsure: Character, Persona, Prompt, and broader StoryBook storage contracts are not complete.

activity.what: Character Book records now reload through the shared browser/Tauri local persistence seam; no UI or StoryBook attachment was added.

features.name: Local Persona Book storage
features.oneLiner: Reusable user-persona records have a validated local repository boundary before legacy library migration or StoryBook attachment.

stories.title: Save and reload reusable Persona Book records
stories.note: Repository and shared local persistence adapter are tested locally; the existing persona hook and UI still use their legacy library path.

decisions.what: Keep Persona Book storage provider- and UI-independent; migrate the existing persona library only after the repository contract is stable.

unsure: Persona-to-StoryBook attachment and the migration path from the existing persona library remain open.

activity.what: Persona records now validate, save, list, delete, and reload through the shared browser/Tauri local persistence seam; no UI migration was added.

features.name: Prompt Library storage
features.oneLiner: Reusable operational and author-facing prompt records have a validated local repository boundary before stacks and Prompt Books are composed.

stories.title: Save and reload reusable Prompt Library records
stories.note: Prompt records validate kind, scope, source, and status through the shared local persistence adapter; Prompt Stacks and Prompt Books remain separate slices.

decisions.what: Use Prompt Library as the storage layer for all reusable prompts while keeping Prompt Stack and Prompt Book as later composition layers.

unsure: Prompt Stack ordering, activation rules, and StoryBook-specific Prompt Book selection remain open.

activity.what: Prompt records now validate, save, list, delete, and reload through the shared browser/Tauri local persistence seam; no stack or UI composition was added.

features.name: Prompt Stack storage
features.oneLiner: Reusable prompts can be composed into model-neutral, author-friendly guidance stacks before compiler rendering is added.

stories.title: Save and reload modular Prompt Stack records
stories.note: Stack entries validate intent, duration, semantic placement, strength, enabled state, order, and optional relative or absolute injection metadata through the shared local persistence adapter. No compiler or UI wiring is claimed.

decisions.what: Keep reusable Prompt Library definitions separate from Prompt Stack composition rules; expose author-friendly intent and duration while retaining provider-neutral placement metadata underneath.

unsure: Prompt Book selection, model-specific Prompt Profiles, compiler rendering, and prompt-reference existence checks remain separate contracts.

activity.what: Prompt Stack repository and local persistence tests passed; the UI/interface layer remains parked.

parkingLot.name: Cloud sync and Supabase expansion
parkingLot.note: Keep the private local-first foundation stable before adding accounts, sync, or cloud persistence.

parkingLot.name: Public production app
parkingLot.note: The current work is intentionally private and local-first; public product surfaces are not the active phase.

parkingLot.name: Full packaged desktop distribution
parkingLot.note: Development packaging exists, but distribution signing and broader release work are outside the current foundation slice.
